interactionPlan.concept: The parallax effect where objects closer to a laterally moving camera appear to move faster than those farther away.

interactions.label: Camera Lateral Speed
interactions.teaches: how changing the speed of the camera affects the motion field observed

interactions.label: Show Depth Variation
interactions.teaches: visualizing how depth affects motion speed of objects

interactions.label: Add/Remove Objects
interactions.teaches: how the motion field changes with different objects at varying depths

interactions.label: Move Camera
interactions.teaches: the effect of moving the camera on the perceived motion direction of objects

interactionPlan.camera_suggestion: positioned above and behind the camera, looking towards the object field
interactionPlan.notes: Ensure depth cues are clear to emphasize distance and motion speed differences.
